_comment: Minimized, sanitized dump-package wire excerpts for Adjudication-001 and 002.
Sources: swift-build package dump-package on swift-foundations/swift-package-graph (remote + mirrored local)
SANITIZATION: local filesystem pathnames are replaced with the artificial stable path
/fixture/checkouts/<name>. THE FIXTURE PRESERVES THE OBSERVED JSON SHAPE, NOT THE
MACHINE-SPECIFIC PATHNAME. Wire keys, array structure, requirement, identity, and the
remote URL are byte-for-byte as observed and MUST NOT be altered.
Full dump was 12079 bytes; only the shapes the adjudications turn on are kept.

fileSystem_path_dependency._note: Genuine .package(path: "..") from swift-foundations/swift-css/Tests, observed alongside the mirror-transformed shapes in a separate dump-package run. NOTE THE THREE DIFFERENCES from sourceControl_location_local: the discriminator is 'fileSystem'; 'path' is a bare String not an array; and there is NO 'requirement' key. Pathname SANITIZED; shape exact.

platforms_element._note: Modelled by SupportedPlatform { platform, version }. 'options' is not modelled.

products_element._note: Modelled by Package.Manifest.Product { name, kind, targets }. 'settings' is not modelled.
products_element.name: Package Graph

sourceControl_location_local._note: Emitted for a dependency whose canonical URL is mirror-redirected to a local directory. 'local' is a bare [String], structurally unlike 'remote's [{urlString}]. The pathname below is SANITIZED; the shape (key name, array-of-string, sibling keys) is exactly as observed. Neither hand decoder reads it; swift-spm-standard's Codable throws keyNotFound("remote") on it.

sourceControl_location_remote._note: Emitted for a dependency absent from the mirror map. This is the only shape all three decoders handle.

unmodelled._note: Observed on the wire, absent from the Package.Manifest domain. None is required by Adjudication-001; recorded so a later slice does not rediscover them.
